Scores your bench for one week. Play it on a double gameweek where all four bench players have two fixtures — a well-set BB returns 15-25 pts. The optimizer's bench EV below is the honest this-week number; compare it against that 15+ bar before burning the chip.

One-week loan squad. Save it for the biggest blank gameweek (most teams without a fixture) or a freak double you can't otherwise exploit; typical value 10-25 pts over a patched squad. Firing it on an ordinary week wastes almost all of that.

Rebuilds the whole squad; value scales with how many dead spots you have. Elite pattern: first wildcard GW4-9 once real form separates from summer prices, second around the season's fixture swings. Don't burn it to fix one player — that's what transfers are for.
